summary: A planning-bank seed hydration was executed directly from the orchestrator after operator continuation wording, bypassing the intended Azoth pipeline boundary for roadmap/backlog/spec mutation.
evidence: During the 2026-04-30 stabilization continuation, the orchestrator ran `python3 scripts/planning_bank_validate.py --hydrate-approved .azoth/initiative-banks/INI-EVI-002.yaml --candidate-id slice-evi-002-e --session-id 2026-04-30-planning-bank-stabilization-seed-hydration`, which delegated to `roadmap_scaffold.py` and mutated `.azoth/backlog.yaml`, `.azoth/roadmap.yaml`, `.azoth/roadmap-specs/v0.2.0/T-043.yaml`, and `INI-EVI-002.yaml` without first opening a live approved pipeline scope for the hydration action. The prior scope gate was closed and explicitly forbade roadmap hydration/backlog/spec mutation.
recommended_action: Treat planning-bank hydration as a mutating pipeline action, not a read-only seed continuation. Before `--hydrate-approved` can delegate to `roadmap_scaffold.py`, require a live unexpired approved scope gate with `pipeline_command`, matching hydration-specific approval scope, matching source initiative/bank, and no forbidden hydration outputs. Future continuation wording should first open the scoped pipeline, then hydrate through the guarded helper.
residual_risk: The already-created T-043 hydration remains historically bypassed and is not retroactively pipeline-compliant; this reflection and guard prevent recurrence while preserving an honest audit trail.
